finding.title: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
finding.untrusted_source: cin >> n, cin >> m, cin >> k, cin >> h
finding.trigger: n, m, k, h being very large values
finding.assumptions: The input values n, m, k, and h are not validated to be within a reasonable range.

finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: n being very large, causing v to overflow
finding.assumptions: The size of vector v is determined by the input n, and no bounds checking is performed when accessing v[i].

finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: n being very large, causing v to overflow
finding.assumptions: The size of vector v is determined by the input n, and no bounds checking is performed when accessing v[i].

finding.title: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
finding.trigger: v[i] being very large, causing overflow in modulo and division operations
finding.assumptions: The values in vector v are not validated to be within a reasonable range before performing modulo and division operations.
